comments.author: github-actions
comments.body:
agentic-code-reviewers v0.4.0 (cursor-sdk)

⚠️ **WARNING:** The gc MCP tool still leaks absolute vault filesystem paths through GcResult.details. purgedFiles and compactedPlans are arrays of full file paths returned from runGc and only passed through sanitizeToolOutput at the tools layer. stripVaultPaths removes object keys named path/filepath/targetPath but leaves plain string elements untouched, so callers receive $SPEC_MEMO_ROOT/projects/... paths in details.purgedFiles and details.compactedPlans.

**Correção sugerida:**

```ts
// Option A: omit absolute paths from caller-facing gc output
return {
  projectId,
  purgedScratchCount,
  purgedReviewCount,
  compactedPlansCount,
  rebuiltFts,
  rebuiltViews: !dryRun,
  dryRun
  // drop details, or replace with ids/slugs only
};

// Option B: extend sanitizeToolOutput to map vault-root-prefixed strings to record ids
```

<details>
<summary>🔍 Detalhes da Análise IA</summary>

**Score:** 7/10 | **Ação dev:** fix-code

**Análise:**
1. Evidence: src/curator.ts pushes absolute filePath values into purgedFiles/compactedPlans and returns them in details (lines 126-138, 164, 193, 224-227). src/tools.ts executeTool('gc') wraps the result with sanitizeToolOutput (lines 382-386, 237-238). src/safety.ts stripVaultPaths only skips keys in VAULT_PATH_KEYS and returns strings unchanged (lines 107-152). 2. Scenario: An agent runs memo gc --json (or MCP gc) after TTL cleanup; the JSON response includes details.purgedFiles with entries such as /home/user/.spec-memo/projects/<projectId>/scratch/<id>.md, exposing vault layout to the host. 3. Protection: src/tools.test.ts checks path stripping for upsert/search but curator.test.ts gc via executeTool only asserts counts, not that details omit vault paths. 4. Discards: Resolved prior findings about SearchHit.filepath referred to keyed fields now stripped; this is a different leak channel via string arrays.

**Caminhos analisados:** /src/curator.ts, /src/tools.ts, /src/safety.ts, /src/types.ts, /src/curator.test.ts
</details>
